A LOAN IS USED ONCE. A CREDIT LINE KEEPS WORKING.

A credit line is closer to a reserve than to a one-off loan. Your assessment sets a personal figure, and that figure stays inside the app until you choose to use it — in part or in full. Repaying does not close it. It refills it.


WHAT THE LIMIT LETS YOU DO

• Draw only what you need — a small amount, or the whole of the figure you were approved for.
• Repay early and owe less: interest stops accruing on what you settle, no penalty is added, and the amount returns to your available limit right away.

• Leave the limit alone and pay nothing. Keeping it open carries no maintenance fee.

• Maximum APR: 18.25%
• Repayment window: 91 to 365 days
• Maximum credit limit: ₹2,00,000
• Processing fee: none
• Penalty for repaying early: none


A SAMPLE REPAYMENT

Suppose your approved limit is ₹50,000 and you draw ₹20,000 for 180 days.

Each day of that draw costs ₹10 in interest (₹20,000 × 0.05%). Over 180 days the interest totals ₹1,800, so ₹21,800 settles the draw completely.

Close the same draw at 90 days instead and the interest is only ₹900 — ₹20,900 in total — and the full ₹50,000 is once again available to draw from.

• A PAN card registered to you personally
• A bank account held in your name

Each limit is worked out individually, so the amount offered to you reflects your own profile and can be smaller than the figure quoted above.


HOW WE TREAT YOUR INFORMATION

Everything you type is encrypted on the device itself before it leaves your phone, and travels over a secure connection to servers operated by us. title: Personal Loan App: Urgent Cash
summary: Need money urgently? Compare personal loans: amount, interest and EMI
description:
Need money urgently and want to know what the loan will actually cost you? See personal loans and instant loan apps in one place: how much is given, for how long, what the interest rate is, and what each lender asks for. Amounts run from a few thousand rupees to several lakh, and the terms differ far more between lenders than most people expect.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND

— Personal loans paid back in monthly EMIs, from small amounts to several lakh
— Short-term and urgent cash loans, for a few weeks until salary
— Loans against an Aadhaar card and PAN, with the documents each lender actually asks for
— Amounts, tenures, interest rates and processing fees placed side by side
— The real requirements: age, monthly income, KYC documents, a bank account in your own name
— Lenders registered with the Reserve Bank of India as banks or NBFCs

CALCULATORS

— EMI calculator: enter amount, tenure and rate, see the monthly instalment
— Total cost: how much you repay above the amount borrowed
— Amortisation schedule month by month: how much goes to principal, how much to interest
— Budget load: what share of your monthly income the EMI would take
— Prepayment: how much shorter the loan gets if you pay a little extra each month
— Compare two offers side by side, with the saving worked out at the end
— Eligibility: the amount that fits comfortably into your income

A FULL WORKED EXAMPLE

A personal loan of ₹50,000 for 12 months at 18% per year on a reducing balance:

— Monthly EMI: ₹4,584
— Total repayment: ₹55,008
— Interest paid: ₹5,008
— Processing fee, typically 1% to 3%, charged once at disbursal: ₹500 to ₹1,500
— GST on the processing fee and on late payment charges: added separately
— Late payment penalty: charged per missed instalment, set by the lender

A longer tenure changes the picture. ₹1,00,000 over 24 months at 16% gives an EMI of ₹4,896, but the interest comes to ₹17,511. The EMI feels lighter every month, yet you pay far more in total. That trade-off is the whole decision, and the app shows both sides of it for every plan you build.

WHAT THE RBI RULES SAY

Before any digital loan is finalised, the lender must give you a Key Fact Statement — a one-page document showing the Annual Percentage Rate, every fee, the total amount repayable, the tenure and the grievance redressal contact. The APR has to capture all costs in one comparable number, so it is the figure worth comparing between offers, not the headline interest rate.

There is also a cooling-off period. If you change your mind after signing, you can exit the loan by repaying only the principal and the proportionate APR, with no penalty. And the money must be transferred directly from the bank or NBFC into your own verified account — never through an app, an agent or a pool account. If someone asks you to route it differently, that is a warning sign.

WORKS SIMPLY

Every calculation runs on your phone. No account, no registration, no phone number, no documents uploaded anywhere.

IMPORTANT

This app is a calculator and information tool. We are not a bank, an NBFC, a lender or a loan agent. We do not lend money, do not accept applications, do not transfer funds and do not decide who receives credit. We do not guarantee approval and do not promise any particular interest rate to anyone.

Every figure here is an estimate based on what you enter. Real terms — the rate, the fees and the eligibility criteria — are set by each bank and NBFC individually and will differ. Confirm the final numbers with the lender, and read the Key Fact Statement, before you commit to anything.

We are not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to the Reserve Bank of India (rbi.org.in), any government body, bank or NBFC. References to regulations are given for information only.

"iMuthoot Muthoot Finance Loans" requires the SEND_SMS and READ_PHONE_STATE permissions to complete device onboarding and prevent digital fraud. The SEND_SMS permission allows the app to send a single, automated verification SMS from your device, while the READ_PHONE_STATE permission is used to access your device's SIM information for verification. Together, these permissions securely bind your physical SIM card to your registered Muthoot Finance account.
During the initial registration process, the application sends a single encrypted SMS to a predefined verification number owned and operated by Muthoot Finance. The SMS contains an encrypted registration payload generated for the current onboarding session and is used exclusively to bind the customer's physical SIM card to their account and registered device.
This SMS is sent only once during account registration and is never used for marketing, messaging, or general communication.
Alternative approaches such as OTP verification, SMS Retriever APIs, or backend verification can verify phone number ownership but cannot establish that the encrypted registration request originated directly from the authenticated SIM installed in the customer's device. Opening the default SMS application would allow the message to be modified, cancelled, or sent from a different SIM, preventing reliable SIM binding and weakening fraud prevention controls. Automatic transmission of the encrypted registration SMS is therefore required to complete secure device onboarding.

Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Punjabi, Kannada and English.

• Khedut diary

• Manual hisab kitab

Kheti hisab, kheti ka hisab, kisan khata, khedut diary, krishi diary, kisan bahi khata, fasal hisab kitab, farm khata or crop expense tracker — whatever you call your farming records at home, Kheti Hisab gives you one simple place to manage them.
